name: queue
description: A real prompt queue: Enter while Claude works queues the prompt instead of steering the running turn, and it is sent when the turn ends. Send now, edit or cancel each one from a band above the prompt.

enterQueues.title: Enter queues while Claude works
enterQueues.description: On: Enter during a turn queues the prompt. Off: Enter steers the running turn as before, and only the queue chord (ctrl+x enter) or /queue <prompt> queues
